sectionHint.bio: Position, age, height, class year, headline and short bio.
sectionHint.attributes: Five 40-99 attributes (squad percentile) and overall, with no availability data.
sectionHint.physical: p95 speed, distances and acceleration over the last year, measured by ATHLOS.
sectionHint.media: Profile photo and player photo already uploaded to the athlete record.
sectionHint.competition: Appearances, minutes, goals and assists from the competition data provider.

card.sealTitle: Data verified by ATHLOS from video/GPS.
card.sealBody: Physical metrics and the attribute card are computed from GPS sessions and match video processed by ATHLOS, not self-reported.
card.attributesNote: 40-99 scale: the athlete's percentile within their own squad, not against the world elite.
card.physicalNote: p95 = the top 5% of measurements, so a single spike does not define the profile.
card.competitionSource: Source: competition data provider ({{providers}}), not measured by ATHLOS.
card.contactNote: Contact goes through the club, never directly to the athlete.

manage.title: Verified profile · {{name}}
manage.description: Shareable profile with data measured by ATHLOS (video/GPS). Only what you select is published, and only with recorded consent.
manage.loadError: Could not load the verified profile
manage.actionError: The action could not be completed
manage.copyError: Could not copy: select the link and copy it manually
manage.regenerateBody: The current link will stop working for everyone who has it.
manage.linkRegenerated: Link regenerated: the previous one no longer works
manage.healthBoundary: Health data is never published: wellness, injuries, injury or fatigue risk, heart rate, body weight or internal notes. Do not write them in the free-text fields either.
manage.headline: Headline
manage.bioHint: Max. 600 characters. No health data or personal contact details.
manage.contactWarning: Use an institutional club contact (e.g. sporting director). Never the athlete's personal email or phone, especially for minors.
manage.athleteConsent: The athlete explicitly agreed to publish this profile.
manage.minorNotice: The athlete is a minor: the profile cannot be published without guardian consent.
manage.noBirthdateNotice: No date of birth on file: the athlete is treated as a minor and guardian consent is required.
manage.evidenceHint: Where the signed form is filed. Never published.
manage.listedHint: Scouts and clubs from other ATHLOS organizations will be able to find this athlete in search. Without it, only people with the link can see it.
manage.unpublishBody: The link will stop working and the profile will leave the showcase immediately.
manage.unpublishedByConsentBody: A required consent was withdrawn, so the link stopped working.
manage.contactEmailHint: Your ATHLOS account email is used. If someone else on staff should receive contacts, have them publish the profile.

publicAthlete.headerTag: Talent verified with video and GPS
publicAthlete.notAvailableBody: The link does not exist, the club unpublished it, or the server is waking up. If you just received it, try again in a few seconds.
publicAthlete.ctaTitle: Want profiles like this for your club or academy?
publicAthlete.ctaBody: ATHLOS measures your athletes with regular video and GPS, without depending on data providers.
publicAthlete.footer: Profile published by the club with the athlete's consent (and their guardian's, if a minor). ATHLOS does not publish health data.

vitrina.title: Verified talent showcase
vitrina.subtitle: Athletes from academies, universities and lower leagues measured by ATHLOS with video and GPS. Only profiles their club chose to publish.

filters.note: Filters only apply to data each club chose to show.

vitrina.emptyBody: Try broadening the search. Only profiles published and listed by their club appear.
vitrina.refineHint: There are more results: refine the filters to see them.
vitrina.detailError: This profile is no longer available
vitrina.emptyAllTitle: The showcase has no profiles yet
vitrina.emptyAllBodyManager: Only athletes whose club published their verified profile, with consent, and turned on "Show in the showcase" are listed. Start with yours: publish them from the list below.
vitrina.emptyAllBody: Only athletes whose club published their verified profile, with consent, and turned on "Show in the showcase" are listed. Ask an admin or coach in your organization to publish their athletes.

roster.title: Your athletes in the showcase
roster.description: An athlete appears in the showcase only after you publish their verified profile with consent and turn on "Show in the showcase".
roster.emptyTitle: Your organization has no athletes yet
roster.emptyBody: Load your roster in Athletes to publish their profiles.
